title: Normalized rational pullback comparisons form a stage morphism
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and a scheme morphism f:X→Y with l invertible in all residue fields. At every finite coefficient inclusion E≤L of [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], conjugate the rational pullback scalar comparison of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations] by the recorded transition identifications from [lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages]. These specific natural isomorphisms rationalPullbackStageComparison satisfy pairFunctorCoherent of [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent], with the associators of the recorded stage systems on X and Y.

proof.text: Build the explicit StageSystem whose functors are transition and whose associators are associator, using associator_cocycle. The uniqueness specification stageSystem_existsUnique identifies it with the recorded stageSystem. Substitute this equality; all transition equality transports in rationalPullbackStageComparison become identities.

Replace the chosen associator by scalarAssociator using associator_existsUnique. Substitute the composition law for actual coefficient inclusions into rationalPullbackScalarComparison_tower. The coefficient-map equality transports then become identities, leaving precisely the required pairFunctorCoherent equation. Compare these maps first as whole natural transformations using the existing normalizedAssociator and associator_formula; only then evaluate at K. This avoids expanding coefficient-equality witnesses inside functor-object conversions.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalPullbackStageComparison_coherent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    StageSystem.pairFunctorCoherent (stageSystem l Ω Y) (stageSystem l Ω X)
      (fun E ↦ rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f)
      (fun {_ _} h ↦ rationalPullbackStageComparison l Ω f h)
